---
title: "wrapped fixture: Typst lengths past the integer range"
filters:
  - wrapped
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
---

A product or sum that passes 2^63 stays positive. A huge `pc` width is a
positive `pt` width, and a huge percent gap beside a percent width warns as
a 100% gap does.

![A figure 768614336404564651 pc wide.](plot.png){#fig-huge-pc .wrap-right width="768614336404564651pc"}
